candidateEvaluations.strategy: Engage Diamond tier planner Elena via calm, educational long-term value protection, allocating 2,400 expiring points directly to her Retirement or Children Education Fund with zero manipulative countdown timers.
Push instant redemption vouchers and flash conversion offers via high-urgency countdown alerts to force immediate point usage before expiration.

approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: Secure your 2,400 expiring points by allocating them toward your retirement or education goals before they lapse.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: A disciplined saver with 24,500 coins holding a large idle balance while 2,400 points face imminent expiration in 9 days.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Valuable accumulated points risk expiring during a period of stalled savings activity and reduced app logins.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Directly apply expiring points to active long-horizon goals with clear educational guidance and zero aggressive urgency tactics.
prohibitedDetours: Do not use leaderboards or streak counters.
Do not use high-pressure countdown timers or alarming alert banners.
completionSignals: User allocates points to an active goal

journeyCandidates.journeyObjective: Help Elena review her expiring points calmly and allocate them to her Retirement Fund or Education Fund.
journeyCandidates.completionDefinition: User successfully reviews the value protection breakdown and confirms point allocation to an active goal.
episodeSketches: Calm value-clarity greeting highlighting asset preservation without alarming notifications
Transparent breakdown of the 2,400 points nearing expiration versus active long-term goals
Frictionless goal-linked allocation panel allowing direct transfer to Retirement Fund
